r16-001.gate_key: cond_first | A2.2 | gap | If you ___ the bus, you ___ late. (miss / be) |

item.q: If you ___ the bus, you ___ late. (miss / be)
item.why: First conditional: *if* + present simple (*miss*), *will* + base verb (*will be*).
item.why_lv: First conditional: *if* + Present Simple (*miss*), *will* + pamatforma (*will be*).

r16-002.gate_key: cond_first | B1.1 | gap | What ___ ___ ___ if you miss the last bus tonight? |

item.q: What ___ ___ ___ if you miss the last bus tonight?
item.why: A question about a possible future: *What will you do…?* (*will* before *you*); the *if*-part keeps the present: *if you miss*.
item.why_lv: Jautājums par iespējamu nākotni: *What will you do*…? (*will* pirms *you*); *if* daļā paliek Present Simple: *if you miss*.
